title: Directional Flow and Mirrored Corner Panels
description: Introduce an explicit directional-flow system for the UI library (ui/js/react/index.tsx): every element gets a horizontal flow (ltr|rtl) and vertical flow (down|up), default LTR+down with icons at the trailing edge (label-then-icon, flipping today's icon-first order globally for Button/Toggle/Action/tab buttons). Tree rows keep icon at flow-start. Mechanism: a FlowProvider React context (cloned from the LevelProvider pattern) that CornerPanel sets from its corner via flowFromCorner(); horizontal mirroring rides on native CSS `dir="rtl"` on the corner-panel root so flex/grid auto-mirror (Tailwind v4's divide-x already emits logical border-inline-*, and built-in logical utilities like text-start/ms-auto exist). Right corners (top-right, bottom-right) become full horizontal mirrors: icon left of label, right-aligned text, tree gutter/chevron/guides on the right, scrollbar on the left. Bottom corners keep only their existing chrome+tab-row vertical mirror (tree content stays top-to-bottom). Work includes: ui.css logical utility additions (ms-*/me-*/ps-*/pe-* alongside existing ml-*/mr-*/pl-*/pr-*), FlowProvider/useFlow/flowFromCorner region, icon-trailing flips at ButtonGroupItem/ToggleGroupItem/ActionGroupItem/Action/PanelTabRow, dir wiring on CornerPanel + portalled overlay content (Popover/Select/Tooltip/Dialog/ContextMenu), physical-to-logical class conversions at enumerated flow-relative sites (tree gutter/guides, labels, navbar toggle, command shortcut, kbd, dropdown check icon, detail-panel, toggle-strip separator) while windows/mode-dock/canvas stay physical, dock drag-and-drop insert-index math inversion for RTL rows in computeTabDockDropZone, test updates/additions, and periphery (ui-interpreter.tsx value row, Storybook Panel stories). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis.md.
summary:
Introduced an explicit directional-flow system for the UI library and made the four corner panels true mirror images of each other.

New `FlowProvider`/`useFlow`/`flowFromCorner` (region 🧭Flow Context, ui/js/react/index.tsx, cloned from the LevelProvider pattern): carries `{inline: "ltr"|"rtl", block: "down"|"up"}`, nesting overrides. `CornerPanel` sets `dir="rtl"` on its root for right corners (top-right/bottom-right) and wraps its subtree in a FlowProvider — this rides on native CSS direction so flex/grid/justify auto-mirror; block flow (already built via flex-col-reverse + Ribbon direction) now derives from the same `flowFromCorner` call instead of a separate `isBottom` computation.

Flipped the global default icon/label order from icon-first to label-then-icon (trailing icon) at the five shared control sites: ButtonGroupItem, ToggleGroupItem, ActionGroupItem, Action, and the panel tab button — under `dir="rtl"` this visually mirrors to icon-left/label-right automatically. Tree-row icons intentionally kept at the flow-start (unchanged) since they're list glyphs, not trailing decorations.

Wired `dir` into portalled overlay content (Popover/Select/Tooltip/Dialog/ContextMenu content, both the Radix-based and imperative controller) so overlays opened from a mirrored panel inherit its flow via context (React context crosses portals).

Converted physical Tailwind utilities to logical ones at flow-relative sites only: `ml-auto`→`ms-auto` (tree controls, navbar fullscreen toggle, command shortcut, kbd hint, dropdown check icon, detail-panel fit control), `text-left/right`→`text-start/end` (tree/property labels, menu items, dialog header, slider/numeric readouts), `border-l`→`border-s` (toggle-strip separator), and the tree gutter/guide/elbow/stem inline `left:`/`paddingLeft`/`marginLeft` styles → `insetInlineStart`/`paddingInlineStart`/`marginInlineStart`. Confirmed empirically (via Tailwind's compile API) that `ms-auto`/`text-start`/`border-s` are v4 core built-ins and that `--spacing-single`/`--spacing-double` (already in `@theme inline`) auto-generate their `ms-*`/`ps-*` named-scale counterparts — so no new custom `@utility` rules were needed in ui.css (a first attempt at adding `ms-single`/`me-single` custom utilities was reverted as redundant dead weight once this was verified). `pl-tiny`/`ps-tiny` remain equally inert before and after (no `--spacing-tiny` scale key exists — pre-existing, out of scope).

Fixed `computeTabDockDropZone`'s insert-index math for mirrored rows: the pointer-fraction-to-model-index mapping now inverts per-row via `cornerHorizontal(row.corner) === \"right\"`, since a mirrored row's DOM/model order stays unchanged while its visual (physical x) order reverses.

Added 7 new in-file vitest tests (flowFromCorner mapping, FlowProvider nesting/defaults, CornerPanel dir attribute per corner, CornerPanel's derived tab-bar stacking direction, computeTabDockDropZone RTL inversion with fabricated rects, label-before-icon markup order for Button/Toggle/panel tabs, logical-class assertions for tree label + navbar trailing slot) and fixed one pre-existing test's literal `margin-left:` string assertion to `margin-inline-start:`.

Verified live in note-react-dev: all four corner panels render with correct `dir` (top-left/bottom-left: none; top-right/bottom-right: rtl); tab button icon renders right of its label in left corners and left of its label in right corners (confirmed via getBoundingClientRect on both sides); screenshots show the mirrored icon placement visually; bottom corners still grow upward from their pinned chrome; expanding a mirrored (top-right) panel shows its content area also flows mirrored.

ui-react vitest suite: 14 failures present both before and after this change (11 previously-known baseline: tree helpers ×5, CanvasPickMenu, Shell*Panel/Dialog ×5; plus 3 more — Mode/Window engagement keydown-routing tests — traced to a concurrent developer's live, uncommitted, in-progress Tree/Layout refactor on this same file, confirmed via `git diff`/`git show HEAD` showing unrelated `showActiveColor` plumbing and dozens of unrelated pre-existing typecheck errors across Tree/WindowLayout/ElementProps code; none reference any Flow/dir/corner/mirroring symbol introduced here). All 7 new tests pass individually and in the full suite. Typecheck currently fails workspace-wide due to that same concurrent in-progress refactor (unrelated errors only — nothing implicates this ticket's code).

ui-interpreter.tsx's value row (flagged in the plan) had no physical flow-relative classes to convert after inspection — left unchanged. Storybook's existing `CornerPanelTopRight`/`CornerPanelBottomRight` stories already render tree-bearing leaves, so they already exercise the mirrored gutter without needing edits.
